description:
This Request for Information (RFI) is posted as a means of conducting market research and there is no solicitation currently. The Government does not intend to award a contract on the basis of this RFI, or otherwise pay for the information requested. Responses are purely voluntary and will be treated as information only and not as a proposal.

The Federal Bureau of Prisons (FBOP) is seeking information from vendors who have integrated a rugged/industrialized tablet with enterprise level software. The intent of this solution would be to modernize daily correctional staff duties. Interested vendors are requested to submit capability/qualification statements with the relevant information requested below by May 4th, 2026.

  1. Hardware & Physical Security Requirements
    • ​​​​​​​Compliance: Trade Agreemets Act (TAA).
    • Ruggedization: Information on devices ruggedness.
    • Access Control: Provide information on access controls such as support multi-factor authentication including secure PINs, biometric verification (e.g., fingerprint or facial recognition), and or PIV access for staff logins, etc..
  2. Operational & Digital Logging Requirements​​​​​​​
    • Presence Verification: Information on capabilities for the system to utilize NFC, RFID, or QR code scanning to provide verifiable proof of location specific entries and data.
    • Real-Time Documentation: Information on capabilities to provide digital templates for housing unit logs, headcounts, incident reports, and other correctional institution data. Capabilities for supporting multimedia attachments (photos/audio) and voice-to-text input.
    • Offline Synchronicity: Information on the systems capability to fully functional in areas with zero network connectivity. Abilities to automatically and securely sync to the central server immediately upon re-establishing a connection.
    • Audit Trails: Ability to maintain forensic integrity of entry, edit, or deletion within the system including time-stamped and tied to a specific user ID to ensure a permanent, unalterable audit trail.​​​​​​​
  3. Artificial Intelligence & Analytics Requirements​​​​​​​
    • Behavioral Analytics: Information on capabilities for AI analyzation of historical and real-time data to identify anomalies in inmate movement or routine that may indicate a security risk or "hot spot."
    • AI Reports: Abilities to utilize AI capabilities to produce detailed customized reports from staff inquiries.
    • Automated Redaction: Capabilities for the system to provide AI-driven tools to automatically redact faces or sensitive identifiers in video and photo evidence to comply with privacy and legal discovery requests.​​​​​​​
  4. System Integration & Compliance Requirements​​​​​​​
    • Data Security: Information and capabilities for data security.
    • System Interoperability: Ability to integrate with current Correctional Management software, and other external data sources.
    • Centralized Management: Capabilities for Mobile Device Management allowing administrators to push updates, restrict applications, and remotely "kill" or wipe lost or stolen devices.
    • Reporting Engine: Ability to generate automated daily, weekly, and monthly reports for compliance monitoring, shift summaries, and facility-wide trend analysis.​​​​​​​
  5. Support & Sustainability Requirements​​​​​​​
    • Training: Capabilities to provide a comprehensive training program, including "train-the-trainer" model, digital user manuals, and course curriculum.
    • Technical Support: Capabilities for offering 24/7/365 technical support with defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for hardware replacement and critical software patches.​​​​​​​
  6. Implementation Costs​​​​​​​
    • Associated Costs: Available information regarding pricing structure to include one-time costs, implementation costs, and annual recurring costs, or recurring maintenance, licensing costs, etc..
  7. Industry Use​​​​​​​
    • Any relevant currently deployed use cases.
